candidates.change_summary: Change the function to return the negation of the stored approvedLoggers value for the caller address argument.
Change the function to always return true regardless of stored mapping.
Change the function to always return false regardless of stored mapping.
Change the function to ignore the provided _caller and instead return the mapping value for msg.sender.
Change the function to return true only if the mapping entry is set and the provided address is not the zero address.
Change the onlyOwner guarded assignment to invert the status value stored (store ! _status instead of _status).
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can change approvedLoggers (authorization removed).
Change stored key to use msg.sender as the mapping key instead of the provided _logger address.
Always set the mapping entry to true regardless of provided _status (force enable).
Change onlyOwner modifier to check against tx.origin instead of msg.sender (different authorization identity).
